verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's main idea: the headline no longer sits layered on the red T. Instead the T is a separate shape parked below the text, so it reads as an unrelated block. A keeps the original line break 'AGAINST CRUELTY' and spreads its weight more evenly, but leaves a big ~135px gap between the text and the T and empty space at the top. B breaks the line awkwardly into 'AGAINST / CRUELTY', and its T stops about two-thirds of the way down, leaving roughly 190px of dead blue space at the bottom, so the layout is lopsided and top-heavy.
